description: Header file defining the AudioAnalytics class for media metrics analysis in Android, including methods for submitting items, dumping analytics data, and managing nested classes for device, health, spatializer, and MIDI logging.

classes.name: AudioAnalytics
classes.description: Main class for collecting and analyzing media audio metrics, with nested classes for device usage, connection, health, spatializer, and MIDI logging.

classes.name: AudioAnalytics::DeviceConnection
classes.description: Manages audio device connection events and states.

classes.name: AudioAnalytics::AAudioStreamInfo
classes.description: Collects info about AAudio streams from client and server sides.

classes.name: AudioAnalytics::Health
classes.description: Tracks audioserver health properties and lifecycle events.

classes.name: AudioAnalytics::Spatializer
classes.description: Tracks spatializer-related messages and device states.

methods.name: AudioAnalytics::submit
methods.description: Processes an item for analytics, verifying key prefix and permissions.

methods.name: AudioAnalytics::dump
methods.description: Returns a string dump of current analytics data with line limit and filters.

methods.name: AudioAnalytics::dumpHeatMap
methods.description: Returns dump of heat map data.

methods.name: AudioAnalytics::dumpHealth
methods.description: Returns dump of health data.

methods.name: AudioAnalytics::dumpSpatializer
methods.description: Returns dump of spatializer data.

methods.name: AudioAnalytics::clear
methods.description: Clears internal analytics state and maps.

methods.name: AudioAnalytics::processActions
methods.description: Handles pending actions for an item.

methods.name: AudioAnalytics::processStatus
methods.description: Handles status information in an item.

methods.name: AudioAnalytics::reportAudioRecordStatus
methods.description: Reports status of audio recording.

methods.name: AudioAnalytics::reportAudioTrackStatus
methods.description: Reports status of audio track.

methods.name: AudioAnalytics::getThreadFromTrack
methods.description: Returns associated thread ID for an audio track.

methods.name: AudioAnalytics::getDeviceNamesFromOutputDevices
methods.description: Extracts device names from output device list.

methods.name: AudioAnalytics::newState
methods.description: Creates a new analytics state.

methods.name: AudioAnalytics::Health::onAudioServerStart
methods.description: Handles start event for audioserver.

methods.name: AudioAnalytics::Health::onAudioServerTimeout
methods.description: Handles timeout event for audioserver crash.

methods.name: AudioAnalytics::Health::dump
methods.description: Dumps health-related data.

methods.name: AudioAnalytics::Spatializer::onEvent
methods.description: Handles spatializer-related events.

methods.name: AudioAnalytics::Spatializer::dump
methods.description: Dumps spatializer data.

methods.name: AudioAnalytics::AAudioStreamInfo::endAAudioStream
methods.description: Handles end of an AAudio stream.

methods.name: AudioAnalytics::DeviceUse::endAudioIntervalGroup
methods.description: Processes end of an audio interval group for device usage.

methods.name: AudioAnalytics::DeviceConnection::a2dpConnected
methods.description: Handles A2DP connection event.

methods.name: AudioAnalytics::DeviceConnection::createPatch
methods.description: Handles creation of audio patch.

methods.name: AudioAnalytics::DeviceConnection::postBluetoothA2dpDeviceConnectionStateSuppressNoisyIntent
methods.description: Handles Bluetooth A2DP connection state notification.

methods.name: AudioAnalytics::DeviceConnection::expire
methods.description: Handles expiration of device connection timer.

methods.name: AudioAnalytics::MidiLogging::onEvent
methods.description: Logs MIDI device events.
